title: SCALE DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local SCALE direct-codec transaction control across inline and detached text layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body and effective text stream, retaining the current AC1012 inline and AC1021 detached-string boundaries, and publish only after all codec writes succeed.

control.profile: Locally generated named SCALE with finite positive paper/drawing units, nonempty name and unit-scale flag.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure returns false and preserves body, text and unrelated handle streams, cursors and handle ledgers. The same SCALE and buffers retry to bytes matching clean output.

validation.result: 3/3 focused CTests passed. This encoder passed all 30 allocation offsets; the combined local encoder allocation control covers 521 offsets across 27 stream/version cases; git diff --check passed.

limits: Generated transaction evidence plus the existing codec vector/graph tests only; no producer prevalence or native consumer claim is established.
Other DWG encoders, complete SCALE graph closure and whole-drawing failure paths remain open.
